verdict: Service in the focus hours is significantly worse than the baseline on late_share.

[A] 92% of headway gaps at the target already existed at 34 St-Penn Station.

[C] 96% of headway gaps at the target already existed at 23 St.

[E] 99% of late trains were already late at 23 St (inherited delay). Origins: at or before 5 Av/53 St: 173, at 50 St: 8, at 7 Av: 5, at or before 34 St-Penn Station: 3. Largest time loss on segment 7 Av -> 50 St (median +50s vs schedule).

49% of hours with problems ran fewer than 90% of scheduled trains (overall service delivered 81%): cancellations or missing trips are creating gaps.

[C] Time is lost a little at every stop (72 St -> 59 St-Columbus Circle +42s, 59 St-Columbus Circle -> 50 St +24s, 42 St-Port Authority Bus Terminal -> 34 St-Penn Station +30s): a dwell-time / crowding pattern rather than one bad segment.

ETAs for problem arrivals drifted 191s on average vs 116s otherwise (1.6x): trains are being held or re-dispatched upstream.

recommendations.action: Audit terminal operations at Jamaica Center-York College during 00:00-01:00, 01:00-02:00, 02:00-03:00, 03:00-04:00: crew reporting, car availability, turnaround time
recommendations.rationale: Trains leave the terminal already late.
recommendations.expected_effect: On-time departures remove the delay at the source.

recommendations.action: Fill cancelled trips on A, C, E during 00:00-01:00, 01:00-02:00, 02:00-03:00, 03:00-04:00: check crew availability and car assignments
recommendations.rationale: Fewer trains than scheduled are running in the problem hours.
recommendations.expected_effect: Restores scheduled headways; largest APT lever available.

recommendations.action: Dwell-time programme at 14 St and the stops before it during 00:00-01:00, 01:00-02:00, 02:00-03:00, 03:00-04:00: platform controllers, door-closing announcements, step-back crews
recommendations.rationale: Run-time loss is spread across every stop on the approach, the signature of long dwells.
recommendations.expected_effect: Each stop recovers its excess dwell; the effect compounds along the line.

recommendations.action: Check weekend / late-night planned service changes for A, C, E; use alternates other lines at the station
recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Check whether scheduled dwell and run times on the approach still match observed loads; re-time the schedule if not
recommendations.rationale: A schedule with unrealistic dwells makes every train late by design.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for A, C, E; add supplement trains or move work windows off 00:00-01:00, 01:00-02:00, 02:00-03:00, 03:00-04:00
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.
